seo.homeDescription: Armonizando Vidas A.B.P. is a nonprofit association transforming communities through the Food Bank and Orquestas del Rey. Donate, volunteer, and join us.

hero.title: Transforming lives,
hero.subtitleStart: We are an organization that brings together the power of
hero.subtitleEnd: to create real social impact in our community.

mission.title: We believe in the power of
mission.text1: Armonizando Vidas was born from the conviction that every person deserves dignity, food, and the opportunity to develop their talents. We work every day to make that vision real.
mission.text2: Our organization combines high-impact social programs with transformative cultural initiatives, creating a community wellbeing ecosystem that goes beyond immediate aid.

dignity.title: Dignity
dignity.desc: We treat every person with the respect and dignity they deserve, regardless of their situation.

community.title: Community
community.desc: We build ties that strengthen the social fabric and create lasting support networks.

excellence.title: Excellence
excellence.desc: We do everything with the highest standard, from food delivery to musical training.

hope.title: Hope
hope.desc: We believe in every human being's potential and work so they can discover it.

programs.title: Two programs,
programs.subtitle: Each program has its own identity, but they share the same purpose: transforming lives through dignity, art, and solidarity.

foodBank.title: Food Bank
foodBank.description: We rescue and distribute food for families in vulnerable situations, fighting hunger and strengthening food security in our community.

orchestra.title: Orquestas del Rey
orchestra.description: We train musicians from childhood, using the orchestra as a tool for social transformation and integral human development through art and excellence.

stats.title: Numbers that
stats.subtitle: Every number represents a family, a life, a story of real transformation.

donate.title: Your support changes
donate.subtitle: With your donation, we keep running the programs that transform entire communities. Every peso counts.

volunteer.title: Join as a
volunteer.subtitle: Your time and talent are the engine that makes our mission possible. There is a place for you on our team.

footer.description: Nonprofit civil association committed to social transformation through food, music, and community.
